description: THE ESTABLISHED LINEAGE — the heart of the pass. An array of connection edges, each drawing one internal representation to one external source under a typed relation, grounded on BOTH sides: a real internal reference and a real external source. The connection IS the lineage; an edge missing either grounding is a claim, not a lineage.

strength.$comment: The weaver DRAWS the grounding strength; the scribe carries it through unchanged into the lineage-record. Ordinal, closed vocabulary — see domain_types/lineage-record.json for the orthogonality note against CitationSchema.evidence_grade (src/genome_schema.ts:293-309).
